gaps.explanation: Same money printed in two sections. The General Fund Schedule of Expenditures (trimmed p14, printed p36) prints 'Debt Service and bond issue cost' 1,626,815.70 (Street column) as an expenditure (in detail). The governmental funds statement (trimmed p5, printed p10, single column) prints the same amount as 'Note Payment' (1,626,815.70) under Other Financing Sources (Uses), not among expenditures (p4). Detail expenditure lines (p14) 2,772,884.66 - Transfers out 60,000.00 (other financing) = 2,712,884.66; statement expenditure lines (p4) 1,086,068.96; difference 1,626,815.70 exactly. The Note Payment is not added as an other-financing line because its money is already in the detail expenditure line (no double counting). (Both printed totals, p4 Total expenditures 1,086,218.96 and p14 Total 2,773,034.66, are 150.00 above their own lines: the report's error, cancels here.) Other financing check: p5 Operating transfers in 182,300.00, Bond Proceeds 1,945,000.00 and Operating transfers out (60,000.00) are all in detail (p13 'Bond proceeds' and 'Transfers in', p14 'Transfers out'); nothing else printed.

Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (trimmed p9, printed p15) prints Miscellaneous 89.75 in the column headed 'Other' (Business-Type Activities, Enterprise Funds; the nonmajor column, Total operating expenses 335,463.46). The Nonmajor Proprietary Funds Combining Statement (trimmed p15, columns Ambulance, Waste) prints no Miscellaneous row (its Waste lines add to 196,381.75 vs printed Total operating expenses 196,471.50), so the 89.75 is in no detail line. Added under the printed column label 'Other' (not attributed to Waste, since no Waste cell prints it). Detail 1,789,498.74 + 89.75 = 1,789,588.49 = statement total. Transfers: detail Electric (72,000), Water (30,000), Sewer (10,800), Ambulance 10,000/(6,000), Waste (13,500) = p9/p15 printed rows (Golf '-'); nothing else missing.
